cues: In eighteen eighty seven, Svante Arrhenius gave the first modern definition.
An acid gives hydrogen ions in water.
A base gives hydroxide ions in water.
It works for hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide.
But it fails in five ways, and the board asks about every one of them.
